claims.statement: The Polish VAT list supplies official, historical taxpayer and registered settlement-account evidence without requiring a proprietary data source.
VoP is a mandatory payer-PSP service for euro credit transfers, free to payment-service users, and non-euro Member States including Poland enter the compliance timetable in 2027.
The EPC VoP API specification and FAQ are expressly limited to inter-PSP communication and do not grant a generic corporate AP application direct query access.
At least one major bank exposes VoP inside its corporate payment flow while providing no separate preflight name/account JSON validation endpoint.
Supplier impersonation and fraudulent account-change requests are recognised BEC scenarios affecting Polish firms and high-value transfers.
Businesses pay for account-verification and master-data workflows: SurePay publishes paid portal tiers, and Trustpair sells overlapping supplier-onboarding, monitoring and ERP-integrated controls.
The defensible paid product must wrap free official checks with supplier remediation, approval evidence, anomaly detection and embedded workflow rather than resell a name match.
A Polish AP, factoring or accounting partner will provide distribution and lawful VoP-result access on commercially viable terms.
A registry-first prototype fits the founder's part-time and capital constraints, but enterprise security and partner integration must be staged after paid demand proof.

contrary_evidence: The legally mandated VoP check is free to the payment-service user.
Published EPC APIs cover inter-PSP traffic only, and direct corporate access is bank-specific.
SurePay and Trustpair already occupy supplier-account validation and approval workflow with established integrations.
Free Polish registry data makes a simple account lookup a commodity.
